profile_text.body:
Okta is a publicly traded identity security company founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, California (Nasdaq: OKTA). The company describes itself as placing identity at the heart of business security and growth, and it operates two platforms, Okta and Auth0, which it says enable secure access, authentication, and automation for employees, customers, and non-human identities.

On the AI side, Okta offers a product called Okta AI, categorized as Security and Identity AI, which the site associates with identity AI, risk-based authentication, privileged access, and identity threat detection. The broader platform is positioned to cover workforce identities, customer identities, and the growing category of non-human identities, reflecting an extension of traditional identity management into automated and AI-driven environments.

The site's held facts show Okta carries an SEC CIK of 0001660134 and has 175 legal matters associated with California exposure, though no specific cases or litigation details are recorded. No MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
